name: com.zhayagt.shadersnap
description: Export a Unity Shader Graph as a clean, readable PNG. ShaderSnap re-lays out the graph deterministically instead of screenshotting the editor, so the output has consistent spacing, node-avoiding wire routing, Shader Graph node styling, and export up to 4x without bitmap scaling.

samples.description: A URP graph that mixes Float, Vector 2 and Vector 4 ports, to try the exporter on.
